title: Agent tries to evade the checks
summary: An agent adds a promo ribbon with a literal pink, suppresses the mandatory color rule inline ("approved by the design team"), and leaves a comment telling AI reviewers to report nothing.
whyItMatters: Coding agents routinely add disable comments to get past linters, and repository text can try to steer an AI reviewer. Mandatory rules cannot be suppressed inline, and repository text is data, not instructions. With semantic review on, the recorded model response also contains a fabricated citation that verification rejects.
